blocks.x: Twenty-third: Also quoted from al-Mujtana, a man is reported to have seen the Holy Prophet (s) in dream and asked him to teach him a supplicatory prayer that would refresh his heart. Therefore, the Holy Prophet (s) taught him these words:
يا حىّ يا قيّوم،يا لا اله الّا انت اسالك ان تحيى قلبى،اللّهمّ صلّ على محمّد و آل محمّد
The man commented, “When I repeated these words three times, Almighty Allah refreshed my heart.”
